about: Allowlist of the quality ratchet (tools/quality_ratchet.py). data_files: glob (repo-relative, forward slashes) -> reason; a matching file is not measured, so declare only data and generated files. A baselined file that leaves measurement fails the check. allowed: one entry per file and metric that may exceed the baseline up to max, each with a reason and a date (YYYY-MM-DD); --update prunes entries the new baseline already covers.

data_files.MidnightSimpleUnitFrames/Locales/[a-z][a: locale packs: one L[english] = translation line per string, checked by the locale tools
data_files.MidnightSimpleUnitFrames_Options/Shell/M: generated by .github/scripts/search_static_index_project.lua (Menu2 search index, Classic clients)

allowed.reason: The Dots on target help is a whole-sentence locale key per client (Midnight keeps the Retail 12.x sentence, the other clients get the game-version one); each literal is longer than 160 characters and a key cannot be split.
